headline: Brokerage and exchange stocks surge on reports of SEBI rolling back CAS mandate
hook: SEBI reportedly scraps controversial CAS proposal
summary: Shares of major Indian exchanges and brokerages including NSE, BSE, Angel One, and Motilal Oswal rallied following reports that SEBI may withdraw the proposed Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) mandate. Market participants reacted positively to the potential regulatory relief, driving a sector-wide uptick in stock prices. This development directly impacts the profitability and operational overhead of listed financial services firms.

why_it_matters: Lower compliance costs may boost brokerage and exchange profit margins
winners_losers: Brokerages and exchanges gain / No clear losers
